title: Stress panel
intro: One sheep for every task we encounter. Watch the load change, services grow and versions hand over to each other.
noTasks: No tasks detected. The panel keeps looking.
connectionError: We are not receiving new data. Retrying automatically; previously detected tasks remain visible until they expire.
apiError: The API service is not responding. Retrying automatically.
note: The percentage is relative to the CPU allocated to each task. Scaling uses the service average over one minute, measured by CloudWatch.
sampling: The panel collects encountered tasks, not the full inventory. After 5 seconds without responses they become ghosts; after 15 seconds they disappear. Updates pause while this tab is hidden.
